SELECT to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS "月份", SUM(o.total_amount) AS "销售额", COUNT(*) AS "订单数" FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.region_code = 'EAST' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH monthly AS (SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, SUM(CASE WHEN so.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-08-01' THEN so.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS july_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN so.order_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-01' THEN so.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_amount FROM sales_orders so JOIN customers c ON so.customer_id = c.id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND c.region_code = 'EAST' AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name) SELECT customer_name AS "客户名称", july_amount AS "7月销售额", august_amount AS "8月销售额", (july_amount - august_amount) AS "销售额下降额" FROM monthly WHERE july_amount > august_amount ORDER BY (july_amount - august_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH monthly AS (SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, SUM(CASE WHEN so.order_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-01' THEN so.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS aug_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN so.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-08-01' THEN so.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS jul_amount FROM sales_orders so JOIN customers c ON so.customer_id = c.id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND c.region_code = 'EAST' AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name) SELECT customer_name AS "客户名称", jul_amount AS "7月销售额", aug_amount AS "8月销售额", (aug_amount - jul_amount) AS "销售额环比变化" FROM monthly WHERE jul_amount > 0 AND aug_amount < jul_amount ORDER BY (aug_amount - jul_amount) ASC LIMIT 1
